#image("/imgs/ap-calc-ab-2011-form-b-frq-06-diagram-01.png", width: 65%)

Let $g$ be the piecewise-linear function defined on $\[- 2 pi \, 4 pi \]$ whose graph is given above, and let $f(x)= g(x)- cos lr((frac(x,2)))$.

(a) Find $integral_(- 2 pi)^(4 pi) f(x) d x$. Show the computations that lead to your answer.

(b) Find all $x$-values in the open interval $(- 2 pi \, 4 pi)$ for which $f$ has a critical point.

(c) Let $h(x)= integral_(0)^(3 x) g(t) d t$. Find $h'lr((- frac(pi,3)))$.
